title: Peninsula Hot Springs Daily Studio Yoga
summary: Daily 45-minute studio yoga at Peninsula Hot Springs (16+), a $20 add-on to a bathing session. Book early-morning or evening slots to avoid the crowd.
suitableFor: Adults 16+; wellness seekers; couples; solo travellers
accessibilityNotes: Wellness Studio accessible; check with venue for specific needs
nearbyAttractions: Geothermal hot springs pools; sauna; body clay ritual; Bass & Flinders Distillery nearby

editorVerdict: A useful $20 add-on if you're already booked in to bathe, not a reason to drive out on its own.
editorNote:
A 45-minute guided yoga session in the Wellness Studio, open to guests aged 16 and over. It is sold as a $20 add-on to your bathing admission, not a standalone class.

The move: book a 7:30am or evening bathing slot when the pools are quieter, do yoga first, then bathe. Avoid the 10am to 4pm window when day-trippers crowd the studio booking. Wellness Studio is indoors so it runs in any weather.
